title: ReadingRecord
description: readings.reading r1: one stored figure value of one subject on one day, with the inputs and parameters that made it.

name.description: Register id of the figure, for example market.ivp_own.

version.description: Version of the register entry that made the reading.

subject_kind.description: Kind of the subject: underlying or market.

subject.description: Subject id: a symbol, underlying:<id> or a FRED id.

day.description: As-of session date of the reading.

rev.description: Revision of the reading for its key; a later rev replaces an earlier one.

value.description: Value as decimal text, at most 12 places; null when the state is missing_input.

currency.description: Currency code when the unit is money, empty otherwise.

state.description: ok: the value was computed; missing_input: an input was missing and the value is null.

reason_code.description: Why the reading is missing, 1 to 5 (3 is stale_input); null when the state is ok.

origin.description: Writer of the reading: the job compute_figures, or the owner command owner_command (the band approval of ot approve-band).

cutoff.description: Cutoff of the inputs; the text session_close.

job_run_id.description: Deterministic identifier of the run that wrote the reading, a uuid.

recorded_at.description: Instant the reading was recorded, UTC.

rows_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sorted input rows in a fixed text form, 64 lower-case hex digits.

inputs.description: Input tables the reading was computed from.

input_table.description: Table the input rows came from.

code_version.description: Hash of the rule that made the reading.

convention_version.description: Version of the conventions the rule used.

value_num.description: Numeric value; null when the parameter is a tag.

value_tag.description: Text value; null when the parameter is numeric.

reading_unit.title: ReadingUnit
reading_unit.description: Unit of a reading value (schema v3 reading_unit).
